age.evidence: weighing between 150 and 300 g at the initial behavioral testing

sex.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats ( n D 112) weighing between 150 and 300 g at the initial behavioral testing were used

dosing.evidence: A dose of DOI (1.25 mg/kg, i.p.) producing a near-maximum of head shakes over a 30 min period was chosen for experiments testing suppression of head shakes by clenbuterol

handling.evidence: All the rats were habituated to the testing environment with a saline injection at least several days prior to the first DOI/vehicle, DOI and clenbuterol/vehicle, or DOI/clenbuterol/ICI-188,551/vehicle injection.

group_housing.evidence: They were housed in suspended stainless wire cages (18 cm x 36 cm x 20 cm) with two to four rats occupying each cage.

day_night_flipped.evidence: The room was illuminated 12 h/day (07:00-19:00). All experiments were performed between 09:00 and 16:00.

assays.assay_description: Rats were placed in a clear polycarbonate cage (43 x 21.5 x 20 cm) with a sawdust-covered floor and observed during consecutive 5-min periods for a total of 30 min following DOI injection. Head twitches, cage crosses (forward locomotion) and rearing were manually counted. Tested with clenbuterol (0.3-3 mg/kg, i.p.) pretreatment and ICI-118,551 (0.01-1 mg/kg, i.p.) co-pretreatment.

application_type.evidence: injected i.p. in a volume of 1 ml/kg body weight

setup_restrain.evidence: The animals were transferred to a clear polycarbonate cage ... The animals were observed during consecutive 5 min periods

water_restriction.evidence: All rats had free access to laboratory chow ... and water except during experimental sessions.

time_to_assay.evidence: The observations began 1 min after injecting DOI to allow time for drug absorption.

sample_size.evidence: Male Sprague-Dawley rats ( n D 112) ... a different cohort of rats was used for each dose ( n D 12/group) ... ( n D 16/each group)

outcomes.summary: DOI (1.25 mg/kg, i.p.) induced ~25.9 head twitches per 30 min. The b2-adrenergic agonist clenbuterol (0.3-3 mg/kg, i.p.) dose-dependently suppressed DOI-induced head twitches by ~55% at 1 and 3 mg/kg, without affecting locomotion or rearing. The selective b2 antagonist ICI-118,551 (0.01-1 mg/kg, i.p.) dose-dependently reversed the clenbuterol suppression, with significant reversal at 0.1 and 1 mg/kg.
outcomes.statistics: Clenbuterol: F(3,33)=3.58, p<0.05; Dunnett p<0.05 at 1 and 3 mg/kg. ICI-118,551 reversal: F(3,60)=4.63, p<0.01; Dunnett p<0.05 at 1 mg/kg. Locomotion: F(3,33)=1.46, p>0.2. Rearing: F(3,33)=0.96.
outcomes.evidence: The b 2-adrenergic receptor agonist clenbuterol (0.3-3 mg/kg, i.p.) suppressed DOI (1.25 mg/kg)-induced head twitches in a dose-dependent manner [ F (3,33) D 3.58, p < 0.05] ... The selective b 2-adrenergic receptor antagonist ICI-118,551 (0.01-1 mg/kg, i.p.) appeared to at least partially reverse the suppression by clenbuterol

B1_num_measures.evidence: In addition to counting each head shake response, forward locomotion (movement from one end to the other end of the cage was scored as one cross) and rearing (rising up on hind limbs) were recorded.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: The animals were observed during consecutive 5 min periods for a total of 30 min ... data analyzed as totals per 30 min (no within-session time-course analysis reported).

B4_ethological.evidence: Head twitch response (HTR) is excluded per rubric; locomotor cage crosses and rearing are scored as basic locomotor/exploratory totals, not as discrete ethological acts.

judge_notes: Only one behavioural assay (DOI-induced head twitch response in rats) was scored; electrophysiology experiments (epinephrine effects on EPSPs in slice) were excluded per rubric as ex vivo / non-behavioural.
All three candidates identified the same single HTR assay; merged into one entry.
B1: scored 2 (2-3 measures) - head twitches, cage crosses, and rearing are three distinct measures (matches glm).
B2: scored 0; although data were collected in 5-min bins, the paper reports only 30-min totals in the analyses shown, so no within-session temporal dynamics analysis is demonstrated.
B4: scored 0; HTR is excluded by rubric, and locomotion/rearing counts as basic locomotor totals rather than discrete ethological acts (overrides gptoss's score of 1).
Handling scored 'yes' based on explicit habituation/saline-injection handling protocol described.
